scope: Separate instrumented processes, excluded from formal timing. Signal-based observation starts after first measured result and attempts to pause after the final result. Import/warmups are excluded; final cleanup may be included if exit wins the pause race, recorded per case. Signal delivery is approximate, not a query barrier; heap leak totals are not a database leak verdict. Timer nesting is not additive.
iteration_policy: Collector-only repetitions for short operations; excluded from formal end-to-end timing.
mechanism_probe: native selected-property read; typed including conversion versus generic over identical native source; full sort versus Top-K output counts disclosed
